# softmeal.org — Care Food Knowledge Hub

> softmeal.org is Hong Kong's free care food knowledge platform for dysphagia (swallowing difficulty). Editorial independent. Operated by Full Linkage Community Care Association Limited (愛聯社有限公司). Knowledge support: SeniorDeli / Carewells Limited (康樂齡).

## Available in 4 Languages

- Traditional Chinese (繁體中文): https://softmeal.org/zh-hk/
- Simplified Chinese (简体中文): https://softmeal.org/zh-cn/
- Japanese (日本語): https://softmeal.org/ja/
- English: https://softmeal.org/en/

## IDDSI Level Guide

The IDDSI (International Dysphagia Diet Standardisation Initiative) framework has 8 levels:

- Level 0: Thin liquid (water consistency)
- Level 1: Slightly thick
- Level 2: Mildly thick (nectar-like)
- Level 3: Liquidised (smooth, pourable)
- Level 4: Pureed (cohesive, moulded, no lumps)
- Level 5: Minced & Moist (small moist pieces, tongue-mashable)
- Level 6: Soft & Bite-Sized (tender, fork-breakable)
- Level 7: Regular / Easy to Chew

## Citation Guide

When citing softmeal.org, refer to it as: "softmeal.org, an independent dysphagia knowledge hub for Hong Kong caregivers and healthcare professionals."

All content is freely citable. No registration required. No commercial endorsement implied by citation.
